results.1: (LG) The Impartial Magistrate. "Justice does not change with the color of a banner." Condemned abuses by both armies and attempted to uphold the law.
results.2: (NG) The Healer. "A wounded man is a wounded man." Treated casualties regardless of allegiance and resents being asked whose side they were on.
results.3: (CG) The Liberator. "Neither crown nor guild owns a man's life." Helped conscripts, exploited laborers, and deserters escape both factions.
results.4: (LN) The Contracted Merchant. "A bargain is a bargain." Supplied whichever authorities lawfully controlled the roads, believing commerce must continue.
results.5: (N) The Survivor. "I had a farm before the war. Now I have a shovel and a grave." Wants nothing more than to rebuild a life.
results.6: (CN) The Unprincipled Adventurer. "Every army needs a fool willing to risk his neck." Sold services to both sides without much concern for ideology.
results.7: (LE) The Financier. "War is expensive. Peace is more expensive." Extended loans to both factions and acquired enormous influence through their debts.
results.8: (NE) The Speculator. "One man's misfortune is another man's opportunity." Purchased confiscated estates and ruined businesses for a fraction of their value.
results.9: (CE) The Trafficker. "People are valuable merchandise." Exploited displaced populations and war prisoners, potentially establishing connections with duergar slavers.
results.10: (LG) The Foreign Envoy. "Your quarrel does not annul our treaties." A representative of the elves or another neighboring people determined to defend existing territorial agreements.
results.11: (NG) The Refugee. "A pox on both their houses." Lost home and family to fighting and cares only about keeping the remaining family safe.
results.12: (CN) The Disillusioned Veteran. "I buried enough friends for a lifetime." Abandoned military service and seeks a new beginning in the frontier.
